timing_evidence.policy: Two actual owner END boundaries; supersedes unimplemented owner-start suggestion.

policies.scope: One Standard candidate Rotten Apple plus11 necessary older printed5-cost collectible candidate dependencies. Eleven existing Adapt choices/token are reused and fully definition-pinned, count0new. No Wild format or exact past pool certification.
policies.apple: Ordinary Heal12SPELL to accepted player current hero then AddPlayerEffect(capture_health_source=True). One native objective duration2 tickturn_ended and classified controller EndTurnSpec. Each accepted end body uses PlayerEffectDamage3 against the current hero of the captured player. Original independent instance/source/lifetime, shared timed-area capacity, health protection/Armor/terminal policy and logical EFFECT classification remain native internal contracts; no local timer, guessed globalturn or custom damage executor.
policies.timing: Complete native EDR_482e explicitly says END of YOUR turn. Current pre-end installation counts that upcoming end. Installation during already captured end reactions is first eligible at a later real owner end. Other-player ends do not tick, extra actual owner ends do. Repeated accepted classified end bodies are separate from once-per-natural-boundary countdown. Exact CN installation/repetition windows pendingM6; raw timing evidence is not a forged API/XML edge.
policies.source: Original logical health source freezes physical card/allocation and beneficiary; later source movement/control/face changes do not retarget the actor or revoke accepted work. Resolve current hero per actual body, not a stored heroID. Shared PlayerEffectDamage supports EFFECT only and does not inherit old source keywords or Spell Damage; this explicit inherited policy remains pendingM6.
policies.bodies: Whelp draws1; Shado-Pan Rider actual Combo grants captured source+4Attack; Songstealer Silences selected minion; Sludge destroys current enemy weapon; Watcher/Alchemist heal selected character8/5EFFECT; EMP/Hemet current Mech/Beast target predicates includeALL and IF_AVAILABLE no-target behavior; Longneck calls the original one-round Adapt recipes; Raider checks successful original manual Inspire history and buffs captured current living self+2/+2; Platebreaker LoseArmor(amount=None) removes actual enemyArmor.
policies.existing: Full frozen existing Adapt definitions and full catalog rows preserved; existing faces/recipes rely on already accepted native Adapt evidence and are not counted as freshly compared primary faces or newly executable definitions. The accepted full assembly binds the newer native Spore recipe but not the older one-round adapt.living_spores.v1 key. This card module explicitly binds that missing key to the unchanged existing engine.adapt._plants helper; it adds no definition/player program and no custom death/summon executor. Both literal Plant bodies are verified by an actual offered Living Spores choice.
policies.qualification: Eleven source-qualified candidate dependencies lack known current Standard families in provided preaudit. Existing EX1_250/CORE_EX1_250 family omitted. Eligibility predicates do not certify every alias or exact historical generation pool.
policies.limits: M0 fixed official CN patch/legal pool, M6 logical health classification/target/lifecycle/end timing and exact past eligibility, all actual reachable content and phase release remain open.
